verdict.rationale: Databricks documents querying its metric views from external BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and Sigma, so dashboard connectivity to named BI tools is a first-party capability. The pack never documents a Databricks JDBC or ODBC driver; Databricks Connect is only described as a client library that works 'just like a JDBC driver', which is not the driver itself. missing for 10: explicit JDBC/ODBC driver documentation, BI-tool connection setup docs beyond metric views, independent or hands-on corroboration of no-glue dashboard connectivity.
